column8: Multiplier that multiplies regen speed / Regen speed is calculated by combining all base regen units and multiplying them by their base regen speed / / ex: / Warlocks have a 1.1x multiplier to grenade regen / Grenadier grants 5x multipier to grenade regen, stacking that with Contraverse's high base regen units results in extreme regen speed / Prismatic subclasses in PvP have an 0.85x multiplier on top of the PvP 0.8x
column10: Effect that grants ability charges / Not supposed to be affected by any scalers
column11: Presented under ability icon in this sheet / Penalty that reduces % and %/s gains' effectiveness / Abilities with longer cooldowns usually have greater penalty / Effects that work on specific abilities may not have penalty / / Prismatic subclasses in PvP have additional 0.8x penalty

The "amount" of regen a certain ability has / Base regen speed is determined by cooldown at 0 stat, which can vary by ability / The default amount of base regen unit is 1x, which can be increased by having more stats invested as shown below
column13: The scaler which affects the energy granted by class mods (Bomber/Outreach/Distribution), these energy are still affected by active scalers corresponding to the ability that get the energy (So double penalty in some cases) / Class abilites with 1x scalers themselves have a 0.4x scaler to the energy granted (Except for Icefall Mantle, which have a 1x scaler) / Class abilites with 0.8x scalers themselves have a 0.6x scaler to the energy granted / Class abilites with 0.5x scalers themselves have a 1x scaler to the energy granted (Except for Arbor Warden, which always stays at 0.4x)
